entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, you came too, [fName]. I was just[n]thinking about contacting you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Take a look.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My mother's painting is finally receiving[n]the public attention that it deserves.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's on display for this week only,[n]so I'm glad we have this chance to[n]view it together.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I am truly blessed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've waited so long to see this painting[n]here. My drive to create a masterpiece[n]of this caliber grows stronger every day...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But thanks to my sensei's patronage,[n]each day also brings me closer to[n]painting such an impactful work.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Nothing in the world could make me[n]happier than I am at this moment.
Whose patronage was that?
Your... who?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Why, my sensei, of course—Madarame.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even after Mother's passing, Sensei[n]never stopped advocating her work[n]to the public.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Not only that, he took me in and cared[n]for me when I lost my only family...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I truly cannot thank him enough.
Yusuke is so happy...
It seems this reality is the[n]one that Yusuke wished for...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, I just had a wonderful idea! Why[n]don't you come join us for dinner?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sensei's been very interested in meeting[n]you. Don't worry—he'll even pay for the[n]meal!
Must everything be perfect?
Is Madarame a good sensei?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, I wouldn't say that everything[n]has to be perfect at all times, but...[n]what's this about, all of a sudden?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, I'd say so, but... What's this about,[n]so out of the blue?
The "Sayuri" looks great there.
Where else could that be?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The... "Sayuri"? That's not the painting's[n]name...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No, wait. That seems... Something's not[n]right.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What are you saying? Where else[n]could it...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No, wait. That's odd... I can distinctly[n]recall having it hung at Leblanc, and...
I have faith in you.
I'll be waiting for you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What is... Could I be making the same[n]mistakes as I did before?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think that this painting was the source[n]of Madarame's distorted desires.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The only saving grace is that my mother[n]won't know of what transpired...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName], I...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Actually—I'm sorry...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...but I'd like to be alone for now.
...It seems all I can[n]do now is wait.
I guess I should head home...
